title: promote-latest: an unreadable promotion record reads as absent, then dies at the exclusive write
description:
Found by the LCLI-641 round-2 reviewer (F3), pre-existing and outside LCLI-641's zero-byte scope.

`scripts/promote-latest.mjs` main() step 4 reads the promotion record as `readFile(args.recordPath, "utf8").catch(() => null)`. The `.catch` collapses EVERY read failure to `null`, not only ENOENT. A PRESENT-but-UNREADABLE record -- e.g. EACCES on a file the operator cannot read -- therefore reads as ABSENT, takes the fresh path, and dies at the exclusive record write `writeFile(args.recordPath, ..., { flag: "wx" })` with an uncaught EEXIST (entrypoint -> exit 2, one-line message, no remedy) -- exactly the failure LCLI-641 fixed for the zero-byte state. The LCLI-641 guard (`existing !== null && existing.trim() === ""`) intercepts only the empty-string case, so an unreadable present file is still indistinguishable from "this is a fresh run".

The fix is to distinguish the read-failure kinds: ENOENT is absence (keep the fresh path); any other failure should be reported by name rather than silently treated as absence.

LESSER ITEMS from the same LCLI-641 round-2 review, to fold in if a fix touches this code:
- F1: the LCLI-641 refusal's mechanism clause is exact for the zero-byte state but not for the whitespace-only state it also names in the same parenthesis. A whitespace-only record read as a truthy string, so the pre-fix code entered `if (existing)` and threw at JSON.parse (SyntaxError, exit 2) -- a different path from the "re-plans and dies at the exclusive record write" the message describes for zero-byte. Behaviour is correct (the shared `.trim()` predicate covers both); only the stated rationale is imprecise.
- F2: the LCLI-641 test pins the whitespace-only case under `--promote` but not under `--dry-run`, though the AC requires the refusal "on --dry-run and --promote alike". The predicate is shared (`.trim() === ""`) so the dry-run branch cannot diverge for whitespace; the assertion just does not hold the whitespace sub-case on both modes.

F4 (the ADR-0005 framing in a review context pack, not a code defect) needs no record.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A PRESENT-but-UNREADABLE promotion record (for example EACCES) is not treated as absent: promote-latest names the read failure by name rather than taking the fresh path and dying at the exclusive record write
